name: Catirpel Queen (3pp)
source: Mystical: Kingdom of Monsters Anniversary Edition
book: Mystical: Kingdom of Monsters Anniversary Edition

facets.bk: Mystical: Kingdom of Monsters Anniversary Edition

body:
As female catirpels grow to the point in which their male counterparts would become chilopodas, their exoskeleton becomes brittle and useless. When the shell finally cracks, the newly formed lepitera is able to leave it behind and fly off immediately.

Monster Trainer Spells
Monstorin Stats

LEPITERA
CR 6

XP 2,400
N Medium magical beast
Init +11; Senses darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +10

DEFENSE

AC 22, touch 17, flat-footed 15 (+7 Dex, +5 natural)
hp 70 (7d10+35)
Fort +9, Ref +10, Will +7 (+4 vs. mind-affecting effects)

OFFENSE

Speed 15 ft., climb 15 ft., fly 30 ft. (perfect)
Melee 4 slams +10 (1d4+5), bite +10 (1d6+5 plus poison)
Spell-Like Abilities (CL 5th)

At will—faerie fire
3/day—glitterdust (DC 16), Magic Missile (3 missiles)

STATISTICS

Str 20, Dex 25, Con 20, Int 12, Wis 22, Cha 19
Base Atk +5; CMB +10 (+14 grapple); CMD 27 (cannot be tripped)
Feats Combat Reflexes, flyby Attack, Improved Initiative, Wingover
Skills Climb +13, Fly +18, Perception +10, Stealth +11 (+23 in forests); Racial Modifiers +4 Perception, +4 Stealth (+12 in forests)

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Poison (Ex)

Bite—injury; save Fort DC 20; frequency 1/round for 6 rounds; effect 1d3 Dex damage; cure 1 save. The save DC is Constitution-based and includes a +2 racial bonus.
